items.title: Cloudflare (NET) Stock Trades Rich Against Its Sales Base
items.summary: Cloudflare has ridden a powerful multi‑year share price run, helped most recently by renewed interest in cybersecurity plays. That puts a spotlight on what investors are really paying for in terms of its sales today. With the stock now framed by sector deal activity and strong longer term returns, the live question is how closely its market value lines up with the revenue the business generates. Over the past 3 years, Cloudflare has delivered a return of about 285.4%, which raises the stakes...
